# Colored pack headings

R0 typography revision. Pack names now use 30px bold Basetica with colorful fills, a dark outline and a small raised shadow: lime Entry, warm cream Bronze, lavender Silver, pale gold Gold and pink Platinum. Prices, fees and availability retain plain black text. The grid minimum grows to 280px and the heading row may wrap, preserving room for selection controls.

124 web tests and production build pass, with the existing dependency build warning. Browser verification passes at 320, 390, 768, 900, 1024 and 1440px: intended heading colors, 30px text, outline rendering, no heading clipping or document overflow, native keyboard selection, unchanged black details and dots. Zero page errors. Mobile and desktop screenshots inspected. Evidence: `artifacts/pack-heading-colors/`.

Local Preview refreshed. No push or deployment. No purchase logic changes.
